CRITICAL HEALTH ADVISORY For Every Butcher, Abattoir Worker & Meat Consumer

KEROSENE KILLS • PETROL IS DEADLY • CAR TYRES CAUSE CANCER

For decades in Nigeria, butchers have used old car tyres, kerosene, and petrol to burn the hair off cows, goats, rams, and pigs. Health institutions and veterinary scientists confirm that burning meat with kerosene, petrol, or tyre rubber releases deadly heavy metals, dioxins, and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons directly into the meat. Eating this meat causes cancer, kidney failure, and organ damage.

Deadly Old Methods (Tyres, Petrol & Kerosene)

DANGEROUS • TOXIC • EXPENSIVE
  • Infuses Cancer-Causing Chemicals: Dioxins, lead, and toxic hydrocarbons enter the meat and stay inside.
  • Horrible Chemical Smell & Taste: Ruins the natural aroma of cow, ram, and goat meat; black soot clings everywhere.
  • Severe Health Hazard to Operators: Inhaling burning rubber and petrol fumes damages workers' lungs and eyes permanently.
  • Painfully Slow & Expensive: Takes 1 to 2 hours of exhausting manual labor per animal, burning through costly fuel.
RECOMMENDED SOLUTION

Quarzard Animal Gas Burner (LPG)

100% HEALTHY • FOOD-GRADE • ULTRA-FAST
  • 100% Non-Toxic & Clean: Liquefied Petroleum Gas burns 100% clean with zero chemical deposits and zero toxic soot.
  • Pure Natural Taste & Golden Color: Animal skin is singed to an attractive, appetizing golden-brown finish with premium market value.
  • Protects Workers' Health: Smokeless operation keeps butchery workers safe from toxic respiratory sickness.
  • Singe in 3 Minutes: High-temperature focused flame clears hair like magic, tripling your daily processing capacity.
